svg.title: Cyella — Stella / Dusty Blue / Universal
svg.desc: A single fixed-color Stella icon for Cyella, intended for use on light and dark surfaces. The featureless left-profile portrait wears a dusty-blue gothic bonnet and dress with warm ivory lace. Muted cream hair, antique gold laurel branches and a champagne-gold four-point star form one consistent palette. The approved geometry, lace details, flowing wreath and starlight placement are unchanged. Transparent background. All colors are fixed SVG fill values; no theme switching, CSS, filters or external resources.
